title: Implement required user accounts for CloudCam AI using Internet Identity

requirements.text: Make Internet Identity the only supported sign-up/login method for CloudCam AI and ensure the app provides a clear, working login flow via the existing /login route.

quotes: Add a user account feature to CloudCam AI so users can sign up and log in.
for number one it can be both

acceptanceCriteria: When unauthenticated, users can navigate to /login and initiate an Internet Identity login.
The login UI clearly indicates authentication is handled via Internet Identity (no email/password UI is presented).
On successful login, the user is considered authenticated in the app shell (header/navigation updates accordingly).

requirements.text: Require authentication (Internet Identity) to use CloudCam AI features by enforcing route protection for all feature pages (at minimum: Dashboard and Camera) and redirecting unauthenticated users to /login.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /dashboard while logged out redirects to /login.
Visiting /camera while logged out redirects to /login.
After logging out, protected routes are no longer accessible until logging back in.

requirements.text: Ensure a basic user account record is created and persisted for each authenticated principal the first time they use the app, without requiring any additional profile fields beyond what already exists (principal, createdAt, tier).

quotes: for number 2 just the basic login for now

acceptanceCriteria: After first successful login, fetching the caller profile results in an existing profile (auto-created if missing).
Creating a profile is safe to call multiple times for the same principal (does not trap or corrupt state).
No new profile fields beyond the existing principal/createdAt/tier are required to complete account setup.

requirements.text: Update all user-facing product name/branding text in the UI to consistently say “CloudCam AI” (English), replacing inconsistent references (e.g., “CloutChem AI”).

quotes: Add a user account feature to CloudCam AI so users can sign up and log in.

acceptanceCriteria: Login page text references “CloudCam AI” (not “CloutChem AI”) in the sign-in messaging.
Header/landing/dashboard user-facing text uses “CloudCam AI” consistently.
No new non-English user-facing strings are introduced as part of this change.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if a state upgrade is required.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Adding expanded user profile fields (e.g., username, bio, avatar) beyond the existing basic account record.
Adding third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
